items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: That name's familiar to me, but I just can't. He's a colored bass player.

ctx.x: I think they lived on, I think one of the members lived on 6th near Law Street, on the downtown side. And they used to hold rehearsals. They were rehearsals quite often. They had violins and things like that, and flutes in the band. And we lived around the corner from them, and I used to hear them rehearse. I think he was a bass player.
Oh, Gaspar, did you ever know him?
That name's familiar to me, but I just can't. He's a colored bass player.
